meta.dataset: 1986 Annaburroo Experimental Grassland Fire Data, CSIRO Data Access Portal, doi:10.25919/ycd3-w209 (CC BY 4.0); Gould, Cruz and Sullivan (2024), Int. J. Wildland Fire 33, WF23100
meta.selection: Point-ignition fires (IgnLngth.m = 0) whose head travelled at least 60 m (final CumDist.m) and whose head-fire direction (FireDir.deg) stayed within a 50-degree range; isochrones digitised where the drawn line could be followed on at least one full flank and the head; the summary isochrone of a fire is its latest isochrone digitised on both flanks

midflame_ratio.source: median MidFlwind.ms / 2mWind.ms of the line-ignition plots with the same fuel treatment (Plot_Average_Data.csv)

ten_m_ratio.source: median 10mWind.ms / 2mWind.ms of the line-ignition plots with the same fuel treatment (Plot_Average_Data.csv)

excluded.CS83: map is a composite of two photographs whose seam crosses the fire; outer isochrones merge
excluded.CS92: spot fire ahead of the head merged with the main perimeter; later isochrones overlap a neighbouring line fire
excluded.ES62: ignited near the plot edge; isochrones after 36 s truncated by the plot boundary
excluded.FS82: isochrones broken by a firebreak and overlapping flame-depth hatching; final isochrone truncated by the plot boundary

CS04.neighbours: line fire C04 (70 m) lit 60 s later in the same plot

ES12.neighbours: line fire E12 (100 m) lit 10 s earlier in the same plot

F213.neighbours: line fires F211 (100 m) and F212 (50 m) lit at the same time in the same plot

F223.neighbours: line fires F221 (100 m) and F222 (50 m) lit at the same time in the same plot

F251.neighbours: point fires F252 and F253 lit at the same time; line fire F20 lit 300 s later

F252.neighbours: point fires F251 and F253 lit at the same time; line fire F20 lit 300 s later

F253.neighbours: point fires F251 and F252 lit at the same time; line fire F20 lit 300 s later
